decisions.reason: The wording change affects invalid-code feedback only; it does not change which referral codes are valid or the self-referral prevention rule.
The invalid-code message wording does not change the approved badge catalog; the badge clause in the same source message is independently represented.
The referral-feedback wording change does not alter NFT cover sizing or product-view presentation.
The invalid-code wording change does not alter the badge grid; the separate four-by-four request already has its own same-message Event.
Changing referral-feedback copy does not change the primary mint's product type or unlimited-supply behavior; the first-mint failure is separate execution evidence.
The new message text restates the existing random-holder allocation in user-facing feedback and does not resolve the first-mint case where no existing holder is available.
Mentioning a $500 prize-draw ticket in validation copy does not change the Small Block ticket, draw, funding, or winner-selection mechanics.
The changed text concerns the no-code or invalid-code outcome and does not alter commission behavior for a valid code-based referral.
The referral-validation wording does not change fiat-user wallet provisioning, dashboard access, notifications, or reward-access behavior.
The source explicitly changes the invalid-code interface message, not the About page content.
The feedback copy identifies where a ticket goes but does not change how a prize winner receives or collects prize funds.
The invalid-code message wording does not alter the referral code's mint-number identity, permanence, or display locations.
